title: Light Lively Vietnamese Kale Bun Cha
description: A rich and springy Vietnamese dish featuring kale and long-fermentation-dough, perfect for a sick day, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly recipe is a delicious and comforting meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped kale and 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, and massage the kale for 2 minutes until it becomes tender.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat, then add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the long-fermentation-dough to the skillet, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, salt, and black pepper, then pour the sauce over the dough and kale mixture, and stir to combine.
Cook the mixture for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the sauce has been absorbed and the dough is cooked through.
Serve the Light Lively Vietnamese Kale Bun Cha hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of black pepper.
Allow the dish to cool for a few minutes before serving, as it will be very hot and steaming.
